mappings.coverage: complete qualified original own-body memory projection
mappings.qualification: 5b3830 caches its scalar and commits components in order, rereading source after each earlier store. 5c11d0 computes/spills Y then Z to private argument cells, computes X using the original first-product order, then commits X/Y/Z. Output may overlap matrix and point; no output mutation occurs until all consumed operands have been read. Exact x87 64-bit significand arithmetic and signed-zero tracking; binary32 stores at original boundaries. Private value-array refinements support caller stack temporaries without new address credit.
